title: Exclusive: Crypto Custodian Anchorage Digital Lays Off 17% Staff
text:
Anchorage Digital, the first federally chartered U.S. digital-asset bank, has cut 17% of jobs, CEO Nathan McCauley told employees this week, according to people familiar with the matter.
